source_scope: Official documented operation descriptions Q1-Q12, not a replay of generated SQL
assumptions: Queries select a concrete device/series identity for this illustrative activation.
Raw-point/range/set queries request two measurements: QUERY_SENSOR_NUM=2.
Q8 is semantically newest single point for a selected device; exact generated SQL has not been parsed.
Q7 and Q11 group by time, not an additional categorical dimension.
Q12 is table dialect only and is a set operation over time range subqueries.
M3 is allowed as a proposal because the chosen scenario is append-oriented; actual DB compaction strategy is not chosen.
TTL, late arrival, hot-series rate, sampling correctness, and workload query frequencies are UNKNOWN: no M2/M4/M5 activation is inferred.
Activation is NOT executable candidate coverage: especially Q12 set operations and TS5 alignment must be validated later.
A1 pilot uses DOUBLE sensors only; no official QUERY_SEED replay.
Time predicates for reference answers use [start,end) as a declared pilot convention, not verified IoTDB SQL.
Do not infer coverage from activated family or CQL DDL.
